# Benchmark

This benchmark:

- times DuckHTS munge against `bcftools +munge`
- compares normalized output groups (`chrom`, `pos`, `ref`, `alt`, `filter`)

# Run

`make bench-munge`

Override stress size with `MUNGE_BENCH_ROWS` and repeats with
`MUNGE_BENCH_RUNS`.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)

drv <- duckdb::duckdb(config = list(allow_unsigned_extensions = "true"))
con <- dbConnect(drv, dbdir = ":memory:")

ext_path <- normalizePath("build/release/duckhts.duckdb_extension", mustWork = TRUE)
DBI::dbExecute(con, sprintf("LOAD '%s';", gsub("\\\\", "/", ext_path)))
DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=4;")

bcftools_bin <- Sys.getenv("BCFTOOLS_BIN", unset = Sys.which("bcftools"))
score_plugin_zip <- Sys.getenv(
  "SCORE_PLUGIN_ZIP",
  unset = normalizePath("score_1.22-20250819.zip")
)
bench_rows <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("MUNGE_BENCH_ROWS", unset = "1000000"))
bench_runs <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("MUNGE_BENCH_RUNS", unset = "3"))
```

```{r helpers, include = FALSE}
shell_quote <- function(x) shQuote(x, type = "sh")

sql_string <- function(x) {
  sprintf("'%s'", gsub("'", "''", x, fixed = TRUE))
}

score_plugin_path <- function() {
  out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "score_1.22-20250819")
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
    dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  }
  candidates <- list.files(
    out_dir,
    pattern = "^munge\\.(so|dylib|dll)$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (!length(candidates)) {
    unzip(score_plugin_zip, exdir = out_dir)
    candidates <- list.files(
      out_dir,
      pattern = "^munge\\.(so|dylib|dll)$",
      recursive = TRUE,
      full.names = TRUE
    )
  }
  normalizePath(candidates[[1]], mustWork = TRUE)
}

write_large_fixture <- function(dir_path, n_rows) {
  dir.create(dir_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  fasta_path <- normalizePath("test/data/liftover_src.fa", mustWork = TRUE)
  score_path <- file.path(dir_path, "munge.tsv")

  template <- data.frame(
    CHR = c("chrF", "chrF", "chrF", "chrF"),
    BP = c(2L, 2L, 2L, 2L),
    A1 = c("A", "C", "C", "G"),
    A2 = c("C", "A", "C", "T"),
    P = c(1e-2, 2e-2, 3e-2, 4e-2),
    OR = c(1.05, 1.10, 1.15, 1.20),
    BETA = c(0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40),
    INFO = c(0.98, 0.98, 0.98, 0.98),
    FRQ = c(0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40),
    SE = c(0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01),
    N = c(1000, 1000, 1000, 1000),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  idx <- ((seq_len(n_rows) - 1L) %% nrow(template)) + 1L
  score <- template[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  score$SNP <- sprintf("bench_%d", seq_len(n_rows))
  score <- score[, c("SNP", "BP", "CHR", "A1", "A2", "P", "OR", "BETA", "INFO", "FRQ", "SE", "N")]

  utils::write.table(
    score,
    file = score_path,
    sep = "\t",
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = TRUE,
    quote = FALSE
  )

  list(
    score_path = score_path,
    fasta_path = fasta_path,
    n_rows = n_rows
  )
}

duckdb_munge_sql <- function(score_path, fasta_path) {
  table_expr <- paste0(
    "(SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto(",
    sql_string(score_path),
    ", delim := '\\t', header := true)) AS score_src"
  )
  paste0(
    "SELECT chrom, pos, ref, alt, coalesce(filter, 'PASS') AS filter, COUNT(*) AS n ",
    "FROM duckdb_munge(", sql_string(table_expr), ", ",
    "preset := 'PLINK', ",
    "fasta_ref := ", sql_string(fasta_path), ") ",
    "GROUP BY ALL ",
    "ORDER BY chrom, pos, ref, alt, filter"
  )
}

run_duckdb_bench <- function(score_path, fasta_path, n = 3L) {
  sql <- duckdb_munge_sql(score_path, fasta_path)
  times <- numeric(n)
  rows <- NA_integer_
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=1")
  on.exit(DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=4"), add = TRUE)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    gc()
    t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    out <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sql)
    times[i] <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0
    rows <- sum(out$n)
  }

  data.frame(
    engine = "duckhts",
    runs = n,
    median_sec = stats::median(times),
    min_sec = min(times),
    max_sec = max(times),
    output_rows = rows,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

run_duckdb_output <- function(score_path, fasta_path) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=1")
  on.exit(DBI::dbExecute(con, "PRAGMA threads=4"), add = TRUE)
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, duckdb_munge_sql(score_path, fasta_path))
}

bcftools_output_sql <- function(output_path) {
  paste0(
    "SELECT CHROM AS chrom, POS AS pos, REF AS ref, ALT[1] AS alt, 'PASS' AS filter, ",
    "COUNT(*) AS bcftools_n ",
    "FROM read_bcf(", sql_string(output_path), ") ",
    "GROUP BY ALL ",
    "ORDER BY chrom, pos, ref, alt, filter"
  )
}

run_bcftools_once <- function(score_path, fasta_path, output_path) {
  plugin <- score_plugin_path()
  plugin_dir <- normalizePath(dirname(plugin), mustWork = TRUE)
  cmd <- sprintf(
    "BCFTOOLS_PLUGINS=%s %s +munge --no-version -c PLINK -f %s -Ob -o %s %s",
    shell_quote(plugin_dir),
    shell_quote(bcftools_bin),
    shell_quote(fasta_path),
    shell_quote(output_path),
    shell_quote(score_path)
  )
  gc()
  t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  status <- system(cmd, ignore.stdout = TRUE, ignore.stderr = FALSE)
  elapsed <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0
  if (!identical(status, 0L)) stop("bcftools +munge failed", call. = FALSE)

  normalized <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, bcftools_output_sql(output_path))

  list(
    elapsed = elapsed,
    output = output_path,
    normalized = normalized
  )
}

compare_outputs <- function(duck_out, bcf_out) {
  names(duck_out)[names(duck_out) == "n"] <- "duck_n"
  merged <- merge(
    duck_out,
    bcf_out,
    by = c("chrom", "pos", "ref", "alt", "filter"),
    all = TRUE
  )
  merged$duck_n[is.na(merged$duck_n)] <- 0L
  merged$bcftools_n[is.na(merged$bcftools_n)] <- 0L

  data.frame(
    duck_rows = sum(merged$duck_n),
    bcftools_rows = sum(merged$bcftools_n),
    only_duck_groups = sum(merged$duck_n > 0L & merged$bcftools_n == 0L),
    only_bcftools_groups = sum(merged$bcftools_n > 0L & merged$duck_n == 0L),
    mismatched_count_groups = sum(
      merged$duck_n > 0L &
        merged$bcftools_n > 0L &
        merged$duck_n != merged$bcftools_n
    ),
    outputs_match = all(merged$duck_n == merged$bcftools_n),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

run_benchmark_case <- function(score_path, fasta_path, n = 3L) {
  duck <- run_duckdb_bench(score_path, fasta_path, n = n)
  duck_out <- run_duckdb_output(score_path, fasta_path)

  bcftools_times <- numeric(n)
  bcftools_out <- NULL
  output_rows <- NA_integer_
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    out_bcf <- tempfile("bcftools_munge_", fileext = ".bcf")
    run <- run_bcftools_once(score_path, fasta_path, out_bcf)
    bcftools_times[i] <- run$elapsed
    output_rows <- sum(run$normalized$bcftools_n)
    if (i == 1L) {
      bcftools_out <- run$normalized
    }
    unlink(c(out_bcf, paste0(out_bcf, ".csi")), force = TRUE)
  }

  list(
    bench = rbind(
      duck,
      data.frame(
        engine = "bcftools",
        runs = n,
        median_sec = stats::median(bcftools_times),
        min_sec = min(bcftools_times),
        max_sec = max(bcftools_times),
        output_rows = output_rows,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    ),
    compare = compare_outputs(duck_out, bcftools_out)
  )
}
```

## Synthetic Stress Case

```{r synthetic, echo = FALSE}
fixture_dir <- tempfile("duckhts_munge_benchmark_")
fixture <- write_large_fixture(fixture_dir, n_rows = bench_rows)
bench_case <- run_benchmark_case(
  fixture$score_path,
  fixture$fasta_path,
  n = bench_runs
)

bench_case$bench
```

```{r synthetic-compare, echo = FALSE}
bench_case$compare
```
